{
  "dataset_name": "ailerons",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "climb_rate_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized climb rate using training mean and std, providing a smooth linear projection axis.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "standardization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Centered and scaled climbRate improves linear margin geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(climbRate - (-10.953212)) / 257.114201"
    },
    {
      "name": "pitch_roll_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of current pitch and absolute roll capturing aircraft attitude severity.",
      "value_range": [-30.0, 30.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear combination of attitude variables gives a useful margin direction.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "curPitch * 2.0 + absRoll * 0.5"
    },
    {
      "name": "pq_rotational_magnitude",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean magnitude of pitch-rate p and roll-rate q, a continuous severity measure of rotational motion.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth nonnegative severity score useful for linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(p * p + q * q)"
    },
    {
      "name": "diff_clb_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of climb-rate change to its acceleration term, capturing dynamic response.",
      "value_range": [-50.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ratio features expose nonlinear interactions in a form linear SVM can exploit.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "diffClb / (np.abs(diffDiffClb) + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "se_mean_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average of all SeTime sensor readings standardized against the global Se mean and std.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_standardization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth aggregate elevator timing signal as a single linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((SeTime1 + SeTime2 + SeTime3 + SeTime4 + SeTime5 + SeTime6 + SeTime7 + SeTime8 + SeTime9 + SeTime10 + SeTime11 + SeTime12 + SeTime13 + SeTime14) / 14.0 - 0.022) / 0.00688"
    },
    {
      "name": "se_time_range",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Spread between max and min of SeTime sensors, indicating timing variability.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.06],
      "feature_family": "dispersion",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures variation in sensor timings as a continuous severity feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(SeTime1, SeTime4), np.maximum(SeTime8, SeTime12)), SeTime14) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(SeTime1, SeTime4), np.minimum(SeTime8, SeTime12)), SeTime14)"
    },
    {
      "name": "diff_se_time_l1",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "L1 norm of all non-zero diffSeTime variables, capturing total elevator timing change.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.05],
      "feature_family": "norm",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous nonnegative magnitude useful for linear separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(diffSeTime1) + np.abs(diffSeTime3) + np.abs(diffSeTime5) + np.abs(diffSeTime7) + np.abs(diffSeTime9) + np.abs(diffSeTime11) + np.abs(diffSeTime13)"
    },
    {
      "name": "climb_pitch_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between climbRate and curPitch capturing climb dynamics, scaled.",
      "value_range": [-2500.0, 2500.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cross-feature interaction surfaced for linear model.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "climbRate * curPitch"
    },
    {
      "name": "alpha_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Deviation of angle of attack alpha from its training mean, log-compressed.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth deviation severity score useful for linear classifier.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.abs(alpha - 0.6246))"
    },
    {
      "name": "roll_rate_signed_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed severity of roll rate change combining direction and magnitude scaled.",
      "value_range": [-10.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "signed_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Preserves sign while compressing magnitude for linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(diffRollRate >= 0, 1.0, -1.0) * np.log1p(np.abs(diffRollRate) * 1000.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "stability_judgment_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic stability assessment combining low absolute pitch rate, low absolute roll rate change, and small climb deviation. Computed as a weighted smooth score where higher values mean more stable flight conditions.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "judgment_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an interpretable stability axis aligned with linear SVM decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.0 / (1.0 + np.abs(p) * 2.0 + np.abs(diffRollRate) * 50.0 + np.abs(diffClb) / 20.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "control_effort_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of control effort combining elevator deflection Se and its timing variability relative to typical values. Higher means more aggressive control input.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "judgment_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures control aggressiveness as a smooth linear-friendly score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Se - 0.012) / 0.057 + np.abs(diffSeTime1) * 100.0 + np.abs(diffSeTime9) * 100.0"
    }
  ]
}
